Having regard to the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the IO is directed to ensure the presence of PW-3 and PW-5 on the next date before the learned Trial Court i.e. 20.12.2023.
10. The Registry is directed to requisition the latest nominal roll of the petitioner from the Jail Superintendent before the next date.

11. Re-notify on 10.01.2024.
